title: Pooja & Daily Aarti Schedule
subtitle: Immerse in the timeless Vedic rituals and sacred five daily Aartis celebrated at Shri Gaurishankar Baikunthnath Dham

aartiSection.title: Five Daily Nitya Aartis
aartiSection.subtitle: Witness the divine sequence of daily offerings and sacred lamps lit for Lord Hari-Hara

items.name: Mangala / Pratah Aarti
items.description: The auspicious morning awakening ritual. The sanctum doors open with the divine conch shell blowing, followed by holy snan and mangala deepam.
items.rituals: Conch blowing, Snan offering, Mangala Deepam, Vedic Stutis

items.name: Shringar Aarti
items.description: Sacred ornamentation ceremony. The deity is adorned with fresh fragrant flowers, chandan tilak, sacred silks, and morning bhog offerings.
items.rituals: Floral ornamentation, Chandan alankaram, Incense offering, Stuti chant

items.name: Madhyahna Bhog Aarti
items.description: Royal noon offering of pure sattvic Mahaprasad prepared in the temple kitchen with holy Ganga jal, followed by Madhyahna Aarti.
items.rituals: Rajbhog offering, Naivedyam, Aarti of 5 wicks, Sanctum midday rest

items.name: Sandhya Maha Aarti
items.description: The grandeur evening Maha Aarti with 108 sacred lamps on the Ganga Ghat promenade accompanied by traditional bells, drums, and Vedic hymns.
items.rituals: 108 Deepam Maha Aarti, Ganga Deep Daan, Damru & Bell resonance

items.name: Shayan Aarti
items.description: The concluding night aarti with soothing lullaby stotras. The sanctum is prepared for night rest and temple gates close at 09:00 PM.
items.rituals: Chamara seva, Shayan stotra recitation, Final sanctum darshan

poojaSection.title: Sacred Vedic Poojas & Anushthan
poojaSection.subtitle: Book personalized Vedic Poojas performed by learned temple priests according to your Gotra and Sankalp

items.name: Shri Rudrabhishek Mahapooja
items.description: Elaborate abhishek of the sacred Hari-Hara composite Shivling with 11 holy dravyas including Ganga jal, cow milk, honey, sugarcane juice, and panchamrit amidst Rudra Suktam chantings.
items.benefits: Removes negative planetary influences, brings peace, health, and spiritual upliftment.

items.name: Ganga Maha Aarti & Deep Daan
items.description: Participate in personalized evening Ganga Aarti on the newly paved stone ghats with holy sankalp, 108-lamp deepotsav, and floating floral diyas.
items.benefits: Purifies karma, blesses the family with divine light, prosperity, and mental tranquility.

items.name: Maha Mrityunjaya Anushthan
items.description: Sacred recitation of 1,100 Maha Mrityunjaya mantras with special havan oblations for health, longevity, and liberation from chronic obstacles.
items.benefits: Bestows divine healing, vitality, and invincible spiritual protection.

items.name: Shri Satyanarayan Vrat Katha
items.description: Traditional Vedic recitation of the five chapters of Sri Satyanarayan Katha with panchamrit, banana prasad, panjiri, and Vishnu Sahasranama archana.
items.benefits: Brings familial harmony, financial abundance, and fulfillment of heartfelt wishes.

items.name: Navagraha Shanti & Havan
items.description: Sacred Vedic fire ritual appeasing the nine cosmic deities (Navagrahas) with specific samagri, ghee oblations, and planetary stotras.
items.benefits: Neutralizes planetary doshas, brings professional success, and clears obstacles.

items.name: Hari-Hara Sahasranama Archana
items.description: Continuous chanting of 1,008 divine names of Lord Shiva and Lord Vishnu offered with sacred bilva leaves, fresh tulsi, and chandan.
items.benefits: Unifies the blessings of both Hari (Vishnu) and Hara (Shiva) for holistic wellbeing.

guidelines.title: Temple Offerings & Devotee Guidelines
guidelines.subtitle: Important guidance to ensure a spiritually enriching pilgrimage

offerings.title: Sacred Offerings for Hari-Hara
items: Fresh Bilva (Belpatra) leaves & Dhatura for Lord Shiva
Fragrant Tulsi leaves & yellow flowers for Lord Vishnu
Pure Ganga jal, cow milk, and organic honey
Chandan (Sandalwood paste), Itra, and pure Camphor

offerings.title: Pooja Timings & Protocol
items: Devotees attending special Abhishek should arrive 15 minutes before scheduled time
Prior online booking is recommended for Rudrabhishek & Havan

offerings.title: Dress Code & Sanctity
items: Traditional Indian attire (Dhoti/Kurta or Pyjama for men; Saree/Salwar for women)
Devotees entering the inner sanctum must observe ceremonial snan purity
Mobile phones must be switched to silent mode inside the sanctum mandap
Photography of the inner sanctum during ongoing Aarti is prohibited
